Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hl=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if Counter(r).most_common(1)[0][0]!=bg and max(Counter(r).values())/w>=0.85]
    vl=[j for j in range(w) if Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(h)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=bg and max(Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(h)]).values())/h>=0.85]
    # corner anomalies on h-line cells that differ from line color; treat them as markers at crossing points
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hl)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vl)-1):
            pts=(hl[i],vl[j]),(hl[i],vl[j+1]),(hl[i+1],vl[j]),(hl[i+1],vl[j+1])
            vals={g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in pts}
            row.append(next(iter(vals)) if len(vals)==1 else None)
        out.append(row)
    res=[]
    prev=None
    for r in out:
        if any(v is not None for v in r) and (prev is None or r!=prev): res.append(r); prev=r
    return [[v if v is not None else bg for v in r] for r in res]
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n,f(G[n+' input']),G[n+' output'])
print('TEST',f(G['Test input']))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def dom(line):
    c=Counter(line); return c.most_common(1)[0][0]
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hl=[i for i in range(h) if dom(g[i])!=bg]
    vl=[j for j in range(w) if dom([g[i][j] for i in range(h)])!=bg]
    M=[[g[hl[i]][vl[j]] for j in range(len(vl))] for i in range(len(hl))]
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(hl)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vl)-1):
            vals={M[i][j],M[i][j+1],M[i+1][j],M[i+1][j+1]}
            row.append(next(iter(vals)) if len(vals)==1 else bg)
        res.append(row)
    # drop all-bg rows and columns
    while any(all(x==bg for x in r) for r in res):
        res.remove(min(range(len(res)), key=lambda i: any(r is None and False for r in [res[i]])))
    # do it properly: remove completely bg rows/cols via mask
    rowsm=[k for k,r in enumerate(res) if any(x!=bg for x in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(max(len(r) for r in res)) if any(res[i][j]!=bg for i in rowsm)]
    res=[[res[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rowsm]
    return res
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n, f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'], f(G[n+' input']), G[n+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def dom(line):
    c=Counter(line); return c.most_common(1)[0][0]

    hl=[i for i in range(h) if dom(g[i])!=bg]
    vl=[j for j in range(w) if dom([g[i][j] for i in range(h)])!=bg]
    def mk(c,i,j): return True if c not in (bg,dom([g[k][j] for k in range(h)])) else False
    # markers: cells != bg and != their line color
    def is_marker(i,j,c):
        lc=dom(g[i]); rc=dom([g[k][j] for k in range(h)])
        return c not in (bg,lc,rc)
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hl)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vl)-1):
            cs=set()
            for k,p in [(0,'T',(hl[i],vl[j])),(0,'B',(hl[i],vl[j+1])),(1,'L',(hl[i+1],vl[j])),(1,'R',(hl[i+1],vl[j+1]))]:
                pass
            top=is_seg_marked(hl[i], vl[j], vl[j+1], g)
            bot=is_seg_marked(hl[i+1], vl[j], vl[j+1], g)
            left=is_seg_marked(vl[j], hl[i], hl[i+1], g)
            right=is_seg_marked(vl[j+1], hl[i], hl[i+1], g)
            cols=[top,bot,left,right]
            if all(x is not None for x in cols) and len(set(cols))==1:

        out.append(row)
    rowsm=[k for k,r in enumerate(out) if any(x!=bg for x in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(max(len(r) for r in out)) if any(out[i][j]!=bg for i in rowsm)]
    return [[out[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rowsm]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def dom(line): return Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0]
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hl=[i for i in range(H) if dom(g[i])!=bg]
    vl=[j for j in range(W) if dom([g[k][j] for k in range(H)])!=bg]
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(hl)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vl)-1):
            vals={g[hl[i+k]][vl[j+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)}
            row.append(next(iter(vals)) if len(vals)==1 else bg)
        res.append(row)
    # drop all-background rows, then all-background columns
    res=[r for r in res if any(x!=bg for x in r)]
    if not res: return []
    n=max(len(r) for r in res)
    res=[[res[i][j] for j in range(n) if any(res[k][j]!=bg for k in range(len(res)))] for i in range(len(res))]
    return res
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n, f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'], f(G[n+' input']), G[n+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def dom(line):
    c=Counter(line); return c.most_common(1)[0][0]
def solve(n):
    g=G[n+' input']; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hls=[i for i in range(H) if dom(g[i])!=bg]
    vls=[j for j in range(W) if dom([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])!=bg]
    out=[]
    for a,b_ in zip(hls,hls[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c_,c__ in zip(vls,vls[1:]):
            cs={g[a][c_],g[a][c__],g[b_][c_],g[b_][c__]}
            sc=dom(g[a])
            # crossing separator color = dominant of the four corner cells
            # but each crossing belongs to two horizontal separators; use either
            sep=cs & {dom(g[a]),dom(g[b_])} or None
            cell=sc if len(cs)==1 and cs=={sc} else bg
            row.append(cell)
        out.append(row)
    return out
